item.title: Daily Minute — September 1, 2026
item.description:
Both bring the same amount of misery, though each one seems to be the way to lose the misery the other brings. Every illusion carries pain and suffering in the dark folds of the heavy garments with which it hides its nothingness. Yet in these dark and heavy garments are those who seek illusions covered, and hidden from the joy of truth.
Truth is the opposite of illusions because it offers joy. Wh

item.title: Lesson 82: We will review these ideas today:
item.description: We will review these ideas today: [63] “The light of the world brings peace to every mind through my forgiveness.” My forgiveness is the means by which the light of the world finds expression through me. My forgiveness is the means by which I become aware of the light of the world in me. My forgiveness is the means by which the world is healed, together with myself. Let me, then, forgive the world
